publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.9 is a maintenance release from main with no application behavior changes since 0.5.8. No migration and no new required settings; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept on upgrade. The pinned @runeditrun/rer stays at 0.2.108; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Known issues: heartbeat output saved by 0.5.6 or earlier is not rewritten, so rotate a key earlier output may have contained; pattern-based redaction can still miss an unlabelled secret of no recognizable shape that is not listed under Output text to mask. A monitor CSV exported from UptimeRobot still cannot be imported (the v3 JSON, an event-log CSV and Uptime's own url CSV are read). Restoring an installation archive does not bring back the list of erased people, so a Business that pairs again after a restore and still lists an erased person could invite them again. A company with a signed agent policy but no company settings still receives an empty decision-feed page rather than a refusal (no token or decision is shared). Response bodies over 64 KiB still fail the check; monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. Other limits from earlier releases remain. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.8. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
